svg.title: The Hook, on paper
svg.desc: Tom's paper map, drawn from map.json. Chosen: the named streets and the water are printed, as on a bought street plan, and always shown; every place mark (plotted places and spots alike) and every back way (the ginnel, the yards' lane, the cuts, the gap) is hidden until Tom has been there or been told of it (part 6.3). No position marker (Q20).
svg.text: and the docks. Quay to the south.

to Copper Row, the Exchange, the Parade, Gullwing

svg.text: Places he has been or been told of are marked in pencil. No "you are here".
